questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ bàba zhème zǎo jiu qǐlai le!

answers.answer_text: Your father got up so early!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tā niánji dà le, měitian shuìde zǎo.

answers.answer_text: He's getting on in years, and he goes to bed early.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xiǎo Wángde yéye yòu hé nèixiē xiǎo péngyou liáo tiānr ne!

answers.answer_text: Xiǎo Wáng's grandfather is talking with those kids again!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tā rén hěn hǎo, hěn xǐhuan háizi.

answers.answer_text: He's a very good person, and he likes children a lot.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèi liǎngnián nǐ nǎinai shēntǐ hǎo ma?

answers.answer_text: Has your grandmother's health been good the past couple of years?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hái hǎo, yǒu shíhou hái néng qǐlai shōushi shōushi wūzi.

answers.answer_text: Fairly good; sometimes she can still get up and straighten up the room.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhāng jiāde érxífu hěn yǒu guīju.

answers.answer_text: The Zhāng family's daughter-in-law is a proper young woman.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì a, Zhāng jiā nǎinai zhēn yǒu fúqi.

answers.answer_text: Yes, the Zhāng family's grandmother is really blessed with good fortune.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Guòqù, Zhōngguo rén chū guó niàn shū duō nán!

answers.answer_text: In the past how difficult it was for Chinese to go abroad to study!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xiànzài hǎo le, zǒu dào nǎr yě méi rén kànbuqǐ le.

answers.answer_text: Now it's better, no matter where they go, no one looks down on them anymore.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Rénjia dōu juéde Xiǎo Wáng shi ge hěn yǒu lǐmàode háizi.

answers.answer_text: Everyone feels Xiǎo Wáng is a very well-mannered child.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèi yìjiā rén dōu niànguo bù shǎo shū.

answers.answer_text: This whole family has had quite a good education.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tīngshuō tāmende sūnzi sūnnǚ xiànzài dōu niàn Sì Shū ne!

answers.answer_text: I understand that their grandsons and granddaughters are all studying the Four Books now!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tāmen jiā guòqù shi yǒu qián rén, yǒu bù shǎo cáichǎn.

answers.answer_text: Their family used to be rich. They had quite a lot of property.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ shuōde cáichǎn shi tǔdì ba?

answers.answer_text: The property you're talking about is land, isn't it?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ zhùxialai ba, yě kěyi gěi wǒmen bāng diǎnr máng.

answers.answer_text: Stay (live) here and you can help us a bit.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ báitian yǒu kè, zhǐ hǎo wǎnshang zuò diǎnr shì.

answers.answer_text: I have classes during the day; I can only work at night.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ mǔqin zǒng dānxīn wǒ gēge zài wàibianr chī kǔ.

answers.answer_text: My mother is always worried that my older brother is having a rough time away from home.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tāmen jǐge xiǎo péngyou hùxiāng bāng máng, bú huì chī kǔde.

answers.answer_text: His bunch of friends help each other out. They don't have such a rough time.
